sv.title: Storbanken: Trump bakom ”skuggrally” på börsen
sv.summary: AI, AI, AI. Det har knappt pratats om annat i år. Ändå får chip- och molnbolagen se sig brädade av en traditionellt defensiv sektor, efter ett ”skuggrally” som president Trump sköt startskottet för ifjol.

en.title: Major bank: Trump behind "shadow rally" on the stock market
en.summary: AI, AI, AI. Hardly anything else has been talked about this year. Yet chip and cloud companies are being outperformed by a traditionally defensive sector, after a "shadow rally" that President Trump kicked off last year.
